shortName.description: What the officials line on match cards calls them (WEB-20); without it, their surname as guessed from the name.

aliases.description: Other names they go by, such as the ones merged into this referee (DUP-3); imports and searches find the referee by them.

distinctFrom.description: Referees the user said aren't the same person, so they aren't suggested as duplicates again (DUP-5).

id.description: The id from the URL; can be left out.

version.description: The version last seen, when updating. Leave it out to create the record.

description: A Referee as a client sends it to save it: the server sets updatedAt and deletedAt, and version only goes with an update.
